name: Smalls
bio: Ricardo "Smalls" Strickland is an American actor, stand-up comedian, and former professional football player, 6′ 2″ (188 cm) tall. His exact birthday and birthplace are not publicly confirmed in major sources. A Desert Storm veteran, he played defensive tackle for the San Francisco 49ers and briefly attended medical school before pursuing entertainment. He began his career on Mad TV and Saved by the Bell, and is best known for his recurring role as Ruben Banks on the UPN series All of Us (2003–2006, produced by Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith). As a stand-up comedian he has performed at The Ice House, The Improv, and The Laugh Factory in Los Angeles.
